answer: You recorded your red road bike at Parking P3 at 08:52:00 (owner check-in, staged demo record). CAM-P3 observed it in place at 13:40:50 [E1]. At 13:40:55 it left its parked position, handled by an unidentified person (track #2) [E2]. A visually similar red bicycle was observed on Riverside path at 13:41:40 [E3] — inferred from adjacent cameras, 39 s travel time and colour similarity 0.59; not a confirmed identity. A visually similar red bicycle was observed on Underpass gate at 13:43:05 [E4] — inferred from adjacent cameras, 81 s travel time and colour similarity 0.59; not a confirmed identity. 2 other bicycle sighting(s) nearby were checked and not linked (colour or timing did not match). No authorized camera covers the route beyond CAM-G2 · Underpass gate — what happened after that is unknown.
